# Fixtures

`0010-base_model.json` and `0011-glossary_model.json` are copied unchanged from
`addons/models/0000-Area0/` of the Apache Atlas `release-2.4.0` tag (commit 4787b75), under the
Apache License 2.0. TDM-20 reads them as Atlas's own type definitions.

`hs2-create-db.json`, `hs2-create-db-v2.json`, `hs2-create-process.json`, `hs2-create-process-v2.json`,
`hs2-create-table.json` and `hs2-create-table-v2.json` are copied unchanged from
`addons/hive-bridge/src/test/resources/json/` of the same tag, under the same licence. They are
`AtlasEntitiesWithExtInfo` bodies as Atlas writes them; ENT-18 reads them and writes them back.
